posts.text:
Between stops in Tampa today, stopped for a bite at Chipotle and met Ryan.

He's in town taking the bar exam and took a minute to say hello and share his support. 

Ryan, good luck this week and thank you for coming over to say hi!

Great to be at the track today and join Cleetus McFarland on the Bald Eagles Podcast. 

Cleetus and his team represent the very best of Florida pride, ingenuity, and hard work.

Thanks for having me—and next time, hopefully I’ll be doing a little more racing!
My full remarks with @ScottforFlorida today at El Arepazo in Doral:

Join us THIS WEDNESDAY, July 29, in Palatka!

Doors open at 2:00 PM, and the event begins at 2:30 PM. We hope to see you there!

RSVP HERE: byrondonalds.com/palatka
